features.title: Converge jobfindsme into a focused multi-source MCP Server
acceptance: Only the four maintained China sources remain executable and documented.
Built-in scheduling, Feishu delivery, and notification configuration are removed.
The core facade delegates search orchestration instead of owning the entire pipeline.
The stdio MCP Server exposes eight focused tools with strict input and output schemas.
Tool annotations, structured output, bounded context, deletion safety, and stderr logging follow MCP guidance.
A built wheel can initialize SQLite, configure a host, and answer an MCP call.
User-visible product naming is lowercase jobfindsme.

research_refs.title: Model Context Protocol architecture
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Keep the domain server focused and let the host own orchestration.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not put host scheduling or notification delivery inside the server.

research_refs.title: Model Context Protocol tools schema
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Expose strict inputSchema, outputSchema, structuredContent, and annotations.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not return unbounded resume or JD payloads by default.

research_refs.title: mcp-jobs
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Use a small job-search tool surface and host-native interaction.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not copy unsupported source coverage claims or lose local state and privacy guarantees.

local_constraints: Core behavior works without a model API key.
BOSS直聘 requires user-authorized local Chrome state.
猎聘 remains useful without Chrome through HTTP discovery.
Historical SQLite migrations and retired enum values remain readable.
The host Agent owns scheduling, notification, and conversation; the Server owns deterministic ranking and base presentation.

features.title: Enforce a host-independent search result contract
acceptance: Every search response contains the same ordered five-section text on every Agent host.
Every displayed job contains facts, match explanation, warnings when needed, a bare apply URL, and a grounded recommendation reason.
Strict salary searches exclude jobs whose salary cannot be verified.
An empty incremental result remains successful and never becomes a duplicate claim or automatic full refresh.
A missing resume path causes one direct question and never a directory scan.
MCP failure produces a bounded doctor action instead of invented CLI search syntax or internal identifiers.
Maintained sources refresh concurrently within bounded connector timeouts.

research_refs.title: MCP client best practices
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Return bounded structured data and a directly usable human-facing result instead of relying on every host to reconstruct presentation.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not expose internal workspace identifiers or raw unbounded records to compensate for host differences.

research_refs.title: mcp-jobs
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Keep job discovery callable through a compact Agent tool surface.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not leave links, recommendation evidence, incremental semantics, or output shape entirely to the host Agent.

local_constraints: The Server-rendered text is the cross-host presentation baseline.
A match score is an explainable signal, never a hiring probability.
Unknown salary cannot satisfy an explicit salary threshold.
No model API key is required for the stable output contract.

features.title: Make matching policy, taxonomy, evaluation, and browser resources explicit
acceptance: Skill aliases are loaded from a versioned packaged JSON resource and community edits are collision-validated.
Salary-constrained searches default to strict handling but support an explicit include-undisclosed policy with warnings and diagnostics.
Production search no longer depends on the historical BM25 matcher; legacy replay code lives under evaluation.
The BOSS page-context request uses a packaged asynchronous script and the installed wheel proves the resource exists.
Synthetic evaluation is an explicit CI regression gate and remains disallowed as public field evidence.
SQLite deletion confirmation remains restart-safe, and retired source values remain readable but non-executable.
Stable human text and validated structuredContent remain the two intentional MCP output surfaces.

research_refs.title: Python importlib.resources
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Ship non-code taxonomies and browser scripts as importable package resources.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not depend on source-tree-relative paths that fail after wheel installation.

research_refs.title: MCP tools specification
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Return validated structuredContent alongside a compatible text result.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not multiply presentation modes when structured output already supports custom clients.

research_refs.title: GitHub Actions Python testing
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Run a deterministic evaluation command in the same reproducible Python CI environment.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not run authenticated browser field trials on hosted CI.

research_refs.title: JobSpy
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Keep source adapters and normalized domain behavior independently testable.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not import source coverage claims or make model-backed ranking mandatory.

local_constraints: No model API key is required for core matching.
Unknown salary never silently satisfies a salary threshold.
Historical migrations are append-only within the current major version.
Field-quality claims require real manually reviewed evidence.

features.title: Validate real four-source quality and incremental behavior
acceptance: A fresh real search snapshot is manually labeled.
P@10, NDCG@10, valid-link rate, source success, and latency are generated by scripts.
A second run proves seen-job suppression and change reporting.
Synthetic data is not used for public quality claims.

research_refs.title: MCP client best practices
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Measure context size and structured-result usability from the client perspective.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not optimize protocol correctness while ignoring end-user result quality.

research_refs.title: JobSpy
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Evaluate each source independently behind a normalized job schema.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not equate scraped record count with qualified-job coverage.

local_constraints: Evaluation uses authorized real searches and manually reviewed labels.
No public quality claim is made until provenance gates pass.

features.title: Publish a reproducible MCP distribution
acceptance: A clean machine can install and list tools without cloning the repository.
The packaged wheel includes migrations and the Agent Skill.
The release has an immutable version and installation smoke evidence.
Official MCP Registry metadata is added only when its package transport is valid.

research_refs.title: Official MCP Registry quickstart
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Publish reproducible metadata only for a supported immutable package.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not add decorative registry metadata before the transport is valid.

research_refs.title: mcp-jobs
research_refs.adopted_pattern: Keep installation and first invocation short enough for Agent users.
research_refs.rejected_or_not_adopted: Do not require source checkout or development dependencies for end users.

local_constraints: End users install a release artifact, not a source checkout.
The local stdio process must continue using the user's SQLite workspace.
